alerte.texte: Ten more pull requests merged, including the single map arrow (Hick's law point 8) and five flaky tests. Your two new TestFlight bugs (vote flicker, frozen conversation) have their tickets and agents.

depuis.texte: CI: the secret scan can no longer be skipped by its cache, and every step has a time limit.
App: when a screen's answer breaks its contract, the app reports which screen and field (never any data), instead of a silent « Couldn't load ».
Hick's law point 8: the map keeps a single arrow, « Around you » gets a list icon, and « Search here » appears when you move the map.
Website: notifications are marked read only up to what you actually saw; « Read all » had no limit at all.
Test only: website tests wait for React to finish before removing their page, which ends random « window is not defined » failures.
Server: traces of a withdrawn vote are forgotten after a minute, as the code says, instead of about an hour.
Test only: two flaky security tests run on a frozen clock, and a rule nobody tested is now tested.
Test only: the avatar editor's flaky tests drive their own clock.
Test only: a flaky KnowMe test on the website now holds its own timers instead of the real clock.
Test loop: on a Mac without cloud storage, the Takes tab no longer shows « Couldn't load »; an image the contract refuses is just left out.
Team only: first step of a performance patrol, a measurement chain marked advisory.
Team only: an observability console, with its screens and a browser SDK for the website and the console.
Private profile: a locked profile now shows Friends, Takes and Score. Your TestFlight point.
Hick's law point 12: in search, « Sort by » stays only on the Top tab; Latest, Photos and Videos keep Date and From.
Hick's law point 3: the sign-in sheet has no cross any more, only « Later » and a swipe down.
CI: the picture check of pull requests no longer takes a bot's logo for a screenshot; only real pictures count.
CI: the app's page names are finally type-checked, so a link to a page that does not exist can no longer pass.
Server: checks of curated videos no longer call the video sites in bursts after a delay; they stay 50 ms apart.
Test loop: the development seed now writes everything the regression loop needs, so no more manual catch-up after each seed.
CI only: the nightly route sweep may now write its tracking tickets.
Messages: a thread opened from a notification now goes back to your inbox with Back, like X and Instagram.
Messages: tapping the Messages tab from inside a thread always lands on your inbox, clearing the threads opened on top.
Website: documents always show in the chosen language, and the welcome page is no longer fetched ahead of time.
A lint rule now blocks the two ways of opening a page that skipped the double-tap guard. Found by the Hick's law audit.
Every pull request that changes the app must now show it breaks nothing (its regression study), or a check fails. Your request of 10/10.
Profile song chip and picker on mobile and web

On the map search, picking a suggestion writes its name in the bar, ready to be written over; the places follow the typing sooner and the flight takes 1.2 s instead of 2.4. Your TestFlight point; for the next build.

Messages and the Profile are prepared ahead while you rest on Amis, switched off by default. Measured on a cloud iPhone: off, it costs nothing; on, it slows nothing and makes launch lighter (12 network reads instead of 22). For the next build.
An official Take's video is removed only when the video site says it is gone twice, a day apart; one passing error no longer removes it for good. It reaches staging with the next server deploy.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.ouEnEst: The vote that flickers (shows, disappears for a third of a second, comes back): the server re-reads the feed from a copy that can lag behind your vote. The conversation that freezes 2 s on the first tap after a cold start: the thread screen's code is only loaded at that tap. Both are being fixed, and the cold-start tap joins the test loop.

enCours.sujet: Hick's law: the last four of the seven you accepted
enCours.ouEnEst: Three are merged (no cross on the sign-in sheet, sorting only on Top, single map arrow). Left: mentions in the most likely order (two pictures to redo), the welcome screen (one picture to redo), and the composer's « No limit » with its header fix and the single sound button (pictures on the Mac).

enCours.sujet: Map search: suggestions follow every letter, with the still panel
enCours.ouEnEst: Your still panel is pushed and reviewed.
enCours.reste: Pictures in light and dark, then merge.
Merge right after the mention ranking.

enCours.sujet: Explore pages going blank during quick changes
enCours.ouEnEst: You want it in build 197: a Replicas machine builds it and takes the pictures and the measurement on a cloud iPhone.
You want it in build 197: a Replicas machine measures it in Release, data size included, with and without the two-line fix.
enCours.reste: If it is smoother, push the fix and merge.

enCours.sujet: Old builds that break when the server adds a field
enCours.ouEnEst: Today one new field can stop an installed build from starting (it broke build 195 on staging). Build 197 will ignore fields it does not know, while the tests stay strict.
enCours.reste: Review, then merge before the build.

enCours.ouEnEst: 15 options on the page; you said you will tell me later.
enCours.reste: Your choice, then a Claude builds it.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me, five Claude agents (your two bugs, reviews, tolerant parsing), audit-hick taking the composer and map pictures, and your emulator on staging.
On Replicas, on Muse Spark through OpenCode: vison (videos ahead, Release measurement), harfang (Explore fix pictures and measurement), wombat (the last pictures). Claude is still out on Replicas.
etapes: Fix your two TestFlight bugs: vote flicker and frozen conversation.
Pictures, then merge: mentions, welcome screen, composer, map search.
Measure and merge the videos ahead and the Explore fix.
Then the full regression loop on the exact build-197 commit, and your OK.
